description: NHFLOW + DEM: 42 floating parcels (light and heavy) driven by a channel flow against a boom; the boom acts on the flow as a B 350 segment (skirt 0.4 m) and on the parcels as a fixed DEM box. Covers the contact loads on fixed particles (REEF3D-DEM-Fixed-Loads.dat) and the heave/roll damping of floating unresolved particles (E 31).
